description: This file defines the 'Image' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Tool' namespace, extending a system engine model. It includes a method 'resize' that handles resizing and caching images for the OpenCart admin tool.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A class responsible for image handling operations such as resizing and caching within the OpenCart admin model.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes an image to specified dimensions, caches the result if necessary, and returns the URL path to the resized image.
